scope: local isolated temporary directories and mock callback API/SSH/systemd
checks: start/ok/changed/failed/skipped callback events for multiple hosts
no_log names and results hidden; module output/arguments never serialized
bounded byte/event pages and partial final line
persisted cursor survives controller restart and lost progress reply
same operation binding and no duplicate Ansible launch
operation/VM mismatch and malformed/oversized batches rejected before logging
cursor-save failure can repeat messages but does not lose the saved position
corrupt/missing progress and optional delivery failures do not change the operation result
callback snapshot is private and does not change on reconnect
successful and failed systemd results remain authoritative
existing stop/dependent cleanup and lifecycle regression tests passed
manual_command_observed: destroy; waited for its processes to finish before editing
limitations: Console delivery is not exactly once across print/save crashes.
At most 16 bounded pages per poll; a very large terminal backlog may remain on the VM.
The new callback has no cloud acceptance; local API mocks do not prove real Ansible loading.
